risk: Fifth member is not on the official repo and the course guideline says teams of three to four; a five-name proposal submitted from a repo he cannot access raises questions
trigger: Still missing from the official repo on Sep 18
response: Ask the professor at the workshop meeting to add him and to confirm the team size

risk: Draft carries AI paste artifacts and no references; the professor spots them at once and the Organization and Writing points go
trigger: Artifact string or chatgpt link still in the .qmd at render
response: Blocking-fix list in the Sep 16 review; a second reader checks the rendered HTML before the push

risk: The professor challenges the topic on the emerging and pre-commercial criteria (smart locks and thermostats are common in new Class A buildings) and asks the team to narrow scope
response: Lead with the design-decision argument: which features to bundle at what premium for mid-market and retrofit stock; no public tradeoff-based WTP exists; be ready to drop lighting or EV charging

risk: Price attribute mis-specified: a zero-dollar premium makes a free smart package a valid profile and there is no base-rent anchor, so the WTP estimates are biased
trigger: Design file generated with the draft levels
response: Fix in SP01: reserve zero for the standard-apartment reference or shift the range; show a base rent in every choice task

risk: Six attributes at three to four levels each overloads respondents and the pilot standard errors are too wide to size the final sample
trigger: Pilot coefficient standard errors dwarf the estimates
response: Pilot with the full set; drop or merge the weakest attribute (lighting is the likely candidate) in FS01

risk: Survey hosting breaks: Supabase not connected, shinyapps deploy fails, or a key leaks into the repo
trigger: Responses not stored in a test run; a key in a diff
response: Assign the account owner by Oct 2 (S07); keys in .Renviron only; end-to-end test on Oct 12 at the latest

risk: Weeks 9 to 13 stack HW8 to HW12, three quizzes and three deliverables; the pilot-to-final handoff has one day of float
trigger: Any pilot-analysis activity slips past its planned finish
response: Start cleaning on partial pilot data (PA02); triage feedback in parallel (PA05); owners agree a weekly time budget before Oct 21

risk: Prolific fielding starts late or runs long over Thanksgiving, leaving days rather than weeks between the final data and the Dec 6 report, with the Dec 2 exam in between
trigger: Launch not confirmed by Nov 11; fewer than the target responses by Nov 25
response: Confirm the launch date at the Nov 11 class; scaffold every script on the pilot data (FA01) so the final run is a re-run

risk: Uneven contribution; the professor grades non-contributors differently and the Attribution section has to be honest
trigger: CONTRIBUTIONS.md shows one or two names for a deliverable
response: Owner and backup per deliverable (S06); contributions logged weekly (O03); raise it at the sync, not at submission

risk: Decisions made on WhatsApp never reach the repo and the team re-argues them
trigger: A decision cannot be found in decisions/DECISIONS.md
response: Same-day copy rule (O01); the tracker maintainer checks the log at each sync
